attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Oregon state income tax calculation. Implements progressive 4-bracket tax structure per OR tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Oregon Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi get result.military_retirement_pay get result.or_military_retirement_taxable get sub sub 0 max /or_agi xdef
or_agi result.or_standard_deduction_single get sub result.or_personal_exemption get sub 0 max /or_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /or_tax xdef
or_taxable_income result.or_single_bracket_1_limit get min 0 max result.or_single_bracket_1_rate get mul /or_tax xdef
or_taxable_income result.or_single_bracket_1_limit get gt if or_taxable_income result.or_single_bracket_2_limit get min result.or_single_bracket_1_limit get sub 0 max result.or_single_bracket_2_rate get mul or_tax add /or_tax xdef then
or_taxable_income result.or_single_bracket_2_limit get gt if or_taxable_income result.or_single_bracket_3_limit get min result.or_single_bracket_2_limit get sub 0 max result.or_single_bracket_3_rate get mul or_tax add /or_tax xdef then
or_taxable_income result.or_single_bracket_3_limit get gt if or_taxable_income result.or_single_bracket_3_limit get sub 0 max result.or_single_bracket_4_rate get mul or_tax add /or_tax xdef then
or_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Oregon tax calculated (Single): $" result.state_tax_liability get cvs strconcat " (Taxable income: $" strconcat or_taxable_income cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.agi get result.military_retirement_pay get result.or_military_retirement_taxable get sub sub 0 max /or_agi xdef
or_agi result.or_standard_deduction_joint get sub result.or_personal_exemption get 2 mul sub 0 max /or_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /or_tax xdef
or_taxable_income result.or_joint_bracket_1_limit get min 0 max result.or_single_bracket_1_rate get mul /or_tax xdef
or_taxable_income result.or_joint_bracket_1_limit get gt if or_taxable_income result.or_joint_bracket_2_limit get min result.or_joint_bracket_1_limit get sub 0 max result.or_single_bracket_2_rate get mul or_tax add /or_tax xdef then
or_taxable_income result.or_joint_bracket_2_limit get gt if or_taxable_income result.or_joint_bracket_3_limit get min result.or_joint_bracket_2_limit get sub 0 max result.or_single_bracket_3_rate get mul or_tax add /or_tax xdef then
or_taxable_income result.or_joint_bracket_3_limit get gt if or_taxable_income result.or_joint_bracket_3_limit get sub 0 max result.or_single_bracket_4_rate get mul or_tax add /or_tax xdef then
or_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Oregon tax calculated (Joint): $" result.state_tax_liability get cvs strconcat " (Taxable income: $" strconcat or_taxable_income cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Oregon military retirement subtraction calculation. Service before Oct 1, 1991: Fully exempt. Service after Oct 1, 1991: Fully taxable. Mixed service: Prorated based on years before/after 1991. National Guard: $6,000 exemption separate from retirement. Honors MSRRA and SCRA per federal law. Source: MOAA State Report Card.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize OR military retirement subtraction calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "OR Military Retirement Subtraction Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.or_military_retirement_taxable xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Mixed service before and after Oct 1, 1991

action_details.action_comment: All service before Oct 1, 1991 - fully exempt
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.or_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"OR military retirement fully exempt (all service before Oct 1, 1991): $" result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat " (Taxable: $0)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.service_years_before_1991 get result.total_service_years get div result.military_retirement_pay get mul /or_pre_1991_portion xdef
result.military_retirement_pay get or_pre_1991_portion sub 0 max /result.or_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"OR military retirement prorated (mixed service): $" result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat " (Pre-1991 years: " strconcat result.service_years_before_1991 get cvs strconcat ", Total years: " strconcat result.total_service_years get cvs strconcat ", Exempt: $" strconcat or_pre_1991_portion cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.or_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: All service after Oct 1, 1991 - fully taxable
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get /result.or_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"OR military retirement fully taxable (all service after Oct 1, 1991): $" result.or_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.or_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No OR military retirement pay - subtraction not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
